_about: community_cases 라벨을 Bulbapedia 원문(data/raw/bulbapedia_rules, data/docs/_src/Damage.txt)·PokeAPI(SQLite)와 대조한 결과. 2026-10-22, Claude가 원문을 읽고 판정(LLM 자동 채점 아님). status: verified=규칙이 원문과 일치 / partial=일부만 확인 / unverified=원문에서 근거를 찾지 못함 / unverifiable=상황 의존·일반론이라 원문으로 판정 불가. verified는 '규칙'이 맞다는 뜻이고 그 패배의 실제 원인을 입증하지 않는다(D30).

A1.evidence: Intimidate (Ability): lowers the Attack stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage
A1.note: 그 턴에 위협이 실제로 있었는지는 상황 의존

A2.evidence: Damage(S3): random integer between 85 and 100, inclusive

A4.evidence: Water Spout (move): base power = floor(150 × HPcurrent / HPmax)

A5.evidence: Damage(S3): Weather 보정은 별도 항, 급소는 랭크·벽만 무시(A·D·Screen 정의)

A8.evidence: Damage(S3): Targets is 0.75 if the move has more than one target

A9.evidence: Damage(S3): A ignoring negative stat stages / D ignoring positive stat stages for a critical hit; Screen is 1 on a critical hit

B1.evidence: Trick Room (move): reverses the move order within each priority bracket
B1.note: 동시 등장 특성 발동 순서가 트릭룸을 따르는지는 원문에서 확인 못함

B2.evidence: Entry hazard: Traps activate before Abilities that activate upon entering battle

B3.evidence: Sucker Punch (move): 대상이 공격기를 골랐고 아직 행동하지 않았을 때만 성공, 그 외 실패

B4.evidence: Priority: When two moves have the same priority, the users' Speed statistics will determine which one is performed first

B5.evidence: Choice Scarf: boosts the Pokémon's Speed by 50%

B6.evidence: Prankster (Ability), Generation VII onward: Dark-type Pokémon are immune to opposing Prankster-boosted moves

B7.evidence: Spore (move) Generation VI onwards / Grass (type): immune to powder and spore moves

B8.evidence: Illusion (Ability): signature Ability of Zorua, Zoroark, and their Hisuian forms

B9.evidence: Inner Focus (Ability), Generation VIII onward: also blocks Intimidate

B10.evidence: Wide Guard (move): 연속 사용 시 성공률 감소는 Generation V only, Generation VII onwards 절에 감소 언급 없음

N1.evidence: Fake Out (move), Pokémon Champions: can no longer be selected for use at all if it is not the first turn
N1.note: Champions 고유 변경, 원문 Champions 절로 확인

N3.evidence: Iron Ball: halves the holder's Speed and makes it grounded

N4.evidence: Priority: same priority → Speed; Aqua Jet·Sucker Punch 모두 +1(PokeAPI move.priority)

N6.evidence: Cloud Nine (Ability): all effects of weather are negated (the weather itself does not disappear)

N7.evidence: Critical hit, Stage modifiers: 원인별 단계가 표로 합산

N8.evidence: Drought (Ability): the slower Pokémon's Ability will override the faster Pokémon's Ability
N8.note: 문장은 Generations III to V 절, Generation VI onward 절에 변경 언급 없음

N9.evidence: Electro Shot (move): no charge turn in rain; Cloud Nine negates weather

N10.note: HP 표시 반올림 규칙을 HP 문서에서 찾지 못함

N11.evidence: Burn: physical damage halved(별도 보정); Reflect: 2732/4096 in Double Battles (Generation VI onward)

N12.evidence: Last Respects (move): base power 50 + 50 per fainted party Pokémon

N14.evidence: Psychic Terrain (move): effects on Pokémon that are on the ground … immune to opponents' moves with increased priority

N15.evidence: Mega Sol (Ability): moves behave as though the weather is harsh sunlight; Weather Ball (move): always Fire-type with Mega Sol

N16.evidence: Weather Ball (move): power doubles to 100 in weather; type-based weather boosts apply in addition

N17.evidence: Weather Ball (move): Fire-type if it is sunny, power 100

N18.evidence: Terrain: The item will activate regardless of whether or not the Pokémon is grounded

N19.evidence: Trick Room (move): using Trick Room while it is already in effect will end it immediately

N20.evidence: N14와 같음(목표가 지면에 있을 때 보호)

T1.evidence: PokeAPI move.priority: trick-room = -7; Priority: 트릭룸은 우선도 구간을 바꾸지 않음

T2.evidence: Prankster: status moves +1 → 트릭룸 -6, blizzard 0보다 늦음(PokeAPI)

T5.evidence: Armor Tail (Ability): blocks moves with increased priority that target the Pokémon with this Ability or its allies

T7.evidence: Last Resort (move): fails unless the Pokémon has used all of its other moves at least once while on the field

T8.evidence: Last Resort (move): 효과가 없거나 빗나간 기술도 사용으로 센다
T8.note: 테일아머 등으로 '실행 전에 막힌' 기술이 사용으로 세어지는지는 원문에 없음

T9.evidence: Levitate (Ability): immune to damaging Ground-type moves

T10.evidence: Competitive (Ability): when a stat is lowered by an opponent, Special Attack +2 stages
